resources.description: This data set contains the average values for the analysis of the pressure dependency of a fuel cell system, derived from the corresponding measurement data. The fuel cell system was developed in the research project cleanEngine in the Laboratory for Hydrogen Technologies and Energy Storage at the Hochschule RheinMain University of Applied Sciences and Arts. From the meta information the units for each sensor parameter as well as the position of the sensor according to the P&ID can be found (Meta information -> Data Model). The P&ID was published with the article "Experimental Optimization..." by Maximilian Kleber et al. This research was funded by Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport (BMDV) of Germany as part of the project cleanEngine under grant number 03B10407B.
